raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The raw_transactions table no longer has an \"amount\" column; the source now delivers it as txn_amount (present in every sampled batch, with USD values in the expected dollar range and no change notes saying otherwise), so silver_transactions fails when it references amount. Mapping txn_amount to amount with the same type and output columns restores the silver and gold tables.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(txn_amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
